Source: Fayetteville State University 2026-2027 'Bachelor of Science in Work and Organizational Psychology Freshman Curriculum Planning Guide and Four-Year Plan' (official, Office of the Registrar; last update 03/2026).
Transcribed from the official Four-Year Plan tables (page 4 of 4). Course titles are the plan's own Requirement labels, since the official plan lists courses by code within requirement buckets; 'See Guide'/'See Catalog' slots are choice slots per the Curriculum Planning Guide. The plan notes some courses may be taken in an alternate order.
Guide scheduling note: PSYC 210, 233, 302, 305, 320, and 331 are prerequisites for upper-level required courses and should be taken as early as possible.
Catalog quirk (transcribed honestly): the official plan lists PSYC 210 both as a Year 1 Fall required major course and as the Year 2 Fall 'Major Restricted Elective'; the Year 2 Fall slot is recorded as a choice slot — complete PSYC 210 once and select the remaining restricted elective per the guide/advisor (guide requires PSYC 210 + SOCI 210 + one from ECON/GEOG/HIST/HIPO/INTL/POLI/PSYC/SOCI; POLI 210 does not count if used for core).
